text: CRDAO code review insurance is funded from the CRDAO Code Review Pool, which consists of the assets raised during the CRDAO token offering plus ten percent of any incoming code review job revenue.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3995709

isBasedOn.name: How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards

abstract: The insurance will be paid from the CRDAO Code Review Pool (CRP) which consists of the assets raised during the CRDAO token offering as well as 10% of any incoming code review job revenue.
